test_item_verbatim: When selected, the head unit will revert to displaying the last known screen.

tcs.tc_title: X exit button reverts the head unit to the last known display
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The "Rear View Camera Delay" setting is On
4. The Radio display was the last display shown before the camera image
5. The shift lever is in D
6. The rear view camera image is displayed during the delay
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "X" exit button on the camera image
2. Read the HU display and check that the Radio display is shown again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "X" exit button registers the press
2. The rear view camera image is removed and the Radio display is shown again
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: X exit button reverts the head unit to the last known display
tcs.test_item:
When selected, the head unit will revert to displaying the last known screen.

(X exit button reverts the head unit to the last known display)

reasoning: §8.1 之後半。`revert to displaying the last known screen` 為逐字；以 Radio 顯示為「last known」之具體值（沿 B01a `-015` 之同一取法）。與 `-038` 之分工：後者驗按鍵之**位置與存在**，本列驗按下後之**行為**。
